summary: Inside the hotel, the Big Cop flicks out his cuffs while the other cops hold a bead on Trinity; they are confident they have her cuffed. But when the Big Cop reaches with the cuffs, Trinity moves with inhuman speed. She snaps her palm up into his face, exploding his nose, then kicks him with wrecking-ball force so that he flies back and slams into the cop farthest from her. Trinity moves again as bullets rake the walls and flashlights sweep in panic while the remaining cops try to stop her. She snatches a gun still in a cop's hand, twists it, and fires. After a final violent exchange of gunfire, Trinity is the only one standing. A flashlight rocks slowly to a stop, and Trinity says, 'Shit.'

what_changes.before: The cops are certain they have her detained, moving to cuff her.
what_changes.after: She breaks free and is the only one left standing.
what_changes.evidence: they know they've got her, until the Big Cop reaches with the cuffs and Trinity moves

what_changes.before: Armed and in control, holding a bead on Trinity.
what_changes.after: All of them are down, leaving Trinity alone standing.
what_changes.evidence: when it's over, Trinity is the only one standing

event_hint.one_line: Trinity, cornered by cops in the hotel, breaks her cuffs attempt and kills them all in a burst of superhuman violence.

uncertain: Whether Trinity is physically wounded in the exchange, since she says 'Shit' but remains standing.
Whether the gun Trinity fires kills the cops or only wounds them, though the text implies they are all down.

minds.wants: To get free of the cuffs and the guns before they close the distance — to leave this room on her feet.
minds.feels: A tight, pre-emptive readiness. She is not surprised by the violence; she is measuring the instant to strike it, because she has already decided she will not be taken. Under it is a low hum of calculation about cost — she knows what this escalation means.
minds.shows: First, studied compliance — hands behind her head, slow, unthreatening (carried over from sc-001). Then, sudden, inhumanly efficient violence with no warning and no wasted motion. At the end, a single human crack: "Shit."
minds.basis: In sc-001 she obeys instantly and silently, which reads as submission but here reads as positioning. In sc-003 she lets the Big Cop reach with the cuffs before moving — she times it, she doesn't flail. After killing the squad she doesn't gloat or panic; she assesses and mutters a single word.

believes_about.belief: They are a routine obstacle — dangerous but ordinary, and she can move through them and be gone.
believes_about.wrong_because: She doesn't yet know these cops are only the opening of what's arriving; the real threat (the Agents) is already outside and has judged the squad as good as dead. Her frame of 'one little girl against a unit' is the cops' frame, not the true one.

believes_about.belief: That their confidence ('they know they've got her') is a liability she can exploit by letting them commit.

minds.wants: To complete the cuffing — the last, rote step of an arrest he believes is already over.
minds.feels: Bored certainty. This is procedure, not a fight; his body is ahead of any real caution because nothing in his experience says this woman can hurt him.
minds.shows: The casual, practiced flick of the cuffs and the reach — the unhurried gesture of a man who has 'done this a hundred times.' He shows nothing defensive because he feels none.
minds.basis: The narration explicitly frames the cops as having 'done this a hundred times, they know they've got her.' His reach is unhurried, which is why the first blow lands before it registers.

believes_about.belief: She is 'one little girl,' already caught, compliant, and physically no match for a full armed unit.
believes_about.wrong_because: She is lethally, inhumanly fast and strong — she kills the biggest of them with a single palm-strike and a kick. His belief is the exact miscalibration that gets him destroyed, and it echoes the Lieutenant's 'one little girl' contempt in sc-002, which Smith has already flagged as fatal.

minds.wants: To hold the bead, back up the Big Cop, and finish the arrest cleanly.
minds.feels: Professional calm that curdles, within a heartbeat, into pure panic. Their certainty has no fallback because they never imagined needing one.
minds.shows: Disciplined aim that dissolves into wild fire — 'BULLETS RAKING the walls' — and flashlight beams 'sweeping with panic.' They show their training right up until it stops being enough.
minds.basis: They hold a bead in confident formation until Trinity moves; then the scene shifts from controlled weapons to raking walls and sweeping lights, the physical signature of men who have lost the target and their composure together.

believes_about.belief: Together, guns drawn and numbers up, they have the situation handled.
believes_about.wrong_because: Their numbers and guns are useless against something that moves faster than the eye. The collective confidence is precisely what leaves them clustered and overwhelmed; the event already told us (via Smith in sc-002) that men in this position end up dead.

connects_back: sc-001: Trinity's silent, immediate compliance ('Hands behind your head! Now!' → she obeys) is re-read here as the set-up for her strike, not surrender.

sc-002: The Lieutenant's 'I think we can handle one little little girl' and Smith's 'your men are already dead' pay off — this scene is the mechanism of that death, confirming the cops' contempt was fatal.
The abandoned, fire-blackened hotel (sc-001) supplies the cramped, shadowed kill-zone that lets a 'leather-clad ghost' move and disappear.
sets_up: ev-001: Trinity surviving and breaking free makes the hallway near-miss with Agent Brown, the fire-escape climb, and the rooftop chase possible.
ev-001: The slaughter of the unit confirms to the Agents that their target is not an ordinary criminal, sharpening their pursuit and the move to Neo as the next target.
The demonstration of Trinity's superhuman speed/strength establishes, for the audience, the physical rules the Agents will match and exceed on the rooftops in ev-001.
dramatic_function: To detonate the illusion of ordinary law-enforcement control and reveal Trinity — and by extension this world — as operating beyond normal human limits, while paying off the dramatic irony planted in sc-002 (the cops are already dead) and launching the chase that defines the event.
